speaker: Doctor
text: Let's start by asking: How long have you noticed the swelling and pain in your right ring finger? Also, is there any redness or warmth in that area?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient reports that the pain and swelling in his right ring finger began 2 days ago while playing football. He recalls his finger got caught in the jersey of another player, who then pulled away forcefully.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Mallet Finger (Extensor Tendon Rupture) with associated swelling. Based on the mechanism of injury (forceful flexion while the finger was extended) and the acute onset of pain and swelling at the distal phalanx, this is the most likely diagnosis. No further imaging is strictly necessary for this classic presentation, but if you wish to confirm the extent of tendon involvement, I can order an X-ray to rule out an avulsion fracture.

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion
